nom: TULA Secret Solution Pro-Glycolic 10% Resurfacing Toner

avis.texte: I returned it and did get the same item and still does have that smell like fish oil,

avis.titre: When I look in the mirror
avis.texte: When I look in the mirror I am much happier with what I see! The overall appearance of my skin is lighter and brighter. My dark spots have faded and I have a more even skin tone. I absolutely love the Secret Solution and I cannot live without it! Thank you TULA for another amazing product!
Love how light weight this product is when applying it after my moisturizer. Makes my skin feel and look great.
Love this stuff and can tell when i dont use it when i fall off my skincare routine. I use this with their plumping moisturizer at noght. Love it

avis.titre: This toner is a best kept secret!
avis.texte: I use this as part of my AM routine before applying moisturizer and/ or sunscreen. I have fair and sensitive skin, it helps calm my monthly breakouts and ensure some glycolic action to even out tone and surface smoothness!
I have been using this toner for about three or so years at this point and it is my absolute favorite. I've tried other ones just out of curiosity and I always come back to Tula.
I bought the travel size of this to try out. Will definitely be buying the bigger size. I feel like it cleaned my face more then my other toners do.

I have used the Tula glycolic secret solution for about 4 years and despite trying other similar products, this is the best for me! It's not only easy to use, I use only 4-5 drops on a cotton pad and swipe over my face after cleansing well am and pm, before any other skin products. I find it important to use especially in the am before I apply other skin care products and make up. It has helped to even out my skin, keep any irritation from getting worse, and overall helps with keeping my skin in balance.

avis.titre: Maybe not my favorite but close!
avis.texte: Not sure this is my A number 1!!!! Item but it is close up there with my favorite The Cult Classic!
I wouldnt recommed this toner to a friend with sensitive skin. It irritated my face immediately after applying.
I put it on at night and then moisturizer. In the morning the dead skin cells peel off and are washed away.
It works and does not sting my sensitive skin. It is making my complexion more even, better than the redness remover toner i bought. I am 54 with dry sensitive skin
this toner has been doing a good job at smoothing my skin's texture, although it did somewhat dry it out (but it didn't irritate, just had to put on more moisturizer)

This toner is easy to use and seems to work well. I like that it doesn't sting or have a harsh scent to it. I would recommend this for someone looking to add a toner or looking for a gentle yet effective one.
The Tula pro-glycolic resurfacing treatment is great. I have been using it for many months and my skin feels and looks amazing.

I started using this product when I got pregnant because I couldn't use my other Products for acne. This was my safest bet. Well I love it! It's a nice gel, pea sized amount so it last forever. Helps keeps my face clear! I had weird skin changes during pregnancy and random acne
Addicted to this! I have seen a more even skin tone and smaller pores. Win-Win.

I love ALL of my Tula products. It's my guilty obsession. I use them religiously BUT when I added this toner, everything changed. This toner is a GAMECHANGER! My skin is softer and way smoother with my crows feet noticeably less visible. THIS toner is incredible and essential to any skin routine, not to mention that it doesn't have all the junk that other products have! Thanks Tula!

This stuff is the equivalent to putting water on your face. I used this twice a day for over a month and saw no improvements anywhere. My face looked the same as it always did. I honestly don't know how this has as many good reviews as it does as you are only paying for a name. $40+ dollars for a name is a lot, so do yourself a favor, don't waste your money.

In addition to the cleanser, this is my second go to product. This is the first natural, cruelty free brand I found effective. Always use this after showering or washing my face. Cleanser, toner, vitamin c, moisturizer.
Very happy with this toner. Great for sloughing off dirt and dead skin at the end of the day. Very refreshing.

avis.titre: Small amount of product for the price
avis.texte: I think it helps with skin texture but its a really small bottle and you have to use it twice a day for it to work, its very mild. It also suggests to put onto a corton pad and then apply, but i botices the cotton pad soaked up all the product, aonit worked better woukd i just used my fingers to apply.

I recently added this toner to my Tula skincare routine and have not been disappointed. It leaves my skin feeling fresh and after a little over a month I can see a slight difference in my complexion - it appears more even (I have some hyperpigmentation in some spots). Love this product!

My favorite toner of all time… I love that it's not watery and I can smear it on with my fingers.. hate having to use cotton rounds or pads all of the time and this you don't need to! I also love the effects from it, I feel like it helps keep my skin clear!

I faithfully use this every night as part of my evening skin care routine. This product has helped even out my skin tone so well. I have sun damage and have had several large patches that darken anytime I would go in the sun. This has completely evened out those areas as well they dont react and darken now when I tan or go in the sun. I feel with any product, consistency is key.

avis.titre: Pump is broken and product won't come out
avis.texte: Makes me mad, this is a expensive product and cantnuse it because the pump doesn't work. Shame on you tula! Charge less and make products better to use and more friendly.

I've been using this product for years as part of my routine and I can't live without it! I have very sensitive skin, acne and breaking out specifically, and Tula products have always agreed with me. I've never had a bad reaction!

Truly the cornerstone my whole routine is standing on. My husband and I joke about how if we don't use this, both of us are all but guaranteed a pimple and it's only funny because it's true. I have really sensitive-dry skin so I only use one pump and dilute it with a hydrating syrum to balance it out. He is combo-oily and even uses it to help the little bumps on his arms. We have been using it for two years and it is still a must-have for both of us.

As someone who deals with sensitivity, especially around my nose (allergies have that area always raw), this toner was great! I only use it usually in the morning, when the rest of my skincare is more hydrating. At night ill use it, if i didnt wear any makeup, but i skip on makeup days since removing my makeup usually irritates my skin just a bit. Overall great product, definitely is a hit or miss like most of their products, so if you are able to ever get their smaller version of this do it!
Not for dry or very senstive skin. It left me burnt around eyes near neck and its not a great purchase for me. Definitely fell for reviews. I wish i could return
Surprised by how much I like this toner! Has made a difference in mild dark marks in my skin
I have only been using for a week but can already see a difference in my pores. So far, I'm loving this product.

This has literally changed the texture and look of my skin completely. It's seriously worked wonders on my acne and the smoothness overall. I use every night followed by moisturizer and it's incredible. Highly recommend.
I started using this toner a couple weeks ago and my skin feels amazing. I use it twice a day and I'm very happy with the results. My skin feels smooth and soft.

My skin is combo and I feel like this adds the perfect amount of moisture but also getting the dirt! I use this every other day morning and night. And it is just perfect! If you are looking for something that is gonna clean out the pores totally recommend this!
I love this toner, my skin is so soft and glowing. I use morning and night after cleansing.
Very nice skincare product. Takes 2 seconds of prep and It helps close my pores so I don't wake up with little pimples anymore! Website is easy and usually has discounts!
My skin regimen is important, this improves the appearance of my skin, it is gentle, not harsh like chemical peels where it leaves you red and blotchy for hours.
Great exfoliation and this was the perfect decision for me to make regarding toner
Love all of the Tula products. The Pro-glycolic resurfacing treatment is a new but for me and I'm loving it too!!!
I have not been using it long, but can already tell a difference in the texture of my skin. Even my esthetician noticed!
I absolutely love this stuff. Make my skin soft, make up looks great and be set of all it has cleared up my uneven skin tone and redness.
Love this product and if you have the money, by all means, purchase it! Too expensive for a college student in my opinion.
I started using this along with the cult classic foaming face wash and wow! That is all I have to say. My skin is better than ever.
This really helps my skin feel more plump and seems to help moisturizer soak in better. I've been loving using this before my makeup routine too!
So far I like it after about 2 weeks of use. It does have a bit of a tingle when first applied but it goes away quickly and seems to be good for my skin. No irritation and skin seems smoother.
It's a nice toner haven't seen a drastic difference in skin tone or texture

avis.titre: I will never go without this!
avis.texte: At 33 years old I've been through it all with my skin! Let's just say at 16 I was using straight rubbing alcohol to "dry out" my pimples - yikes. A few years ago you wouldn't catch me without moisturizer bc my skin was always dry & flaky. I was curious about skin care & I am SO GLAD I tried this on a whim bc it's completely transformed my skin! It's hydrating and made my skin feel plump and fresh. It's honestly made me look younger and I buy bottles 2 at a time so I never go without!

I LOVE this toner! my skin feels so much better and I notice a difference each time I use it. I've been consistently adding to my Tula collection over the past year and my skin is finally clearing up after years of struggling with acne and discoloration. This stuff works!

I added this to my skincare routine a couple months ago for scarring that I have. I can't say that the appearance of the scars have really changed, but the overall texture of my skin has, it appears so much smoother on my cheeks and areas where there is no scarring. I'm hopeful that with long term use the blackhead scarring will improve over time.
This is amazing for every age and skin type you will be left soft and hydrated!
Every other tone I've tried has made me skin breakout- this one is so gentle. Perfect for sensitive skin!

I found that the product was easy to pump from the bottle and did not notice any smell. The texture is greasy and when applied to my skin it would slightly burn. After using this product my skin started breaking out, even though I used the Tula cleanser. Did not work for my skin, but there were some aspects I like: the packaging, the way my skin felt hydrated, the product feels light weight, and it dispenses well.
I've been using this product for several months now. It has done wonders for the texture of my skin. Love it!
I have been so happy with how this is helping the appearance and feel of my skin.

avis.titre: Useful in my Korean Skincare/Skin Cycling Arsenal
avis.texte: Easy to use toner with minimal irritation to my usually sensitive skin. Use as part of my skin cycling routine combined with a K-Skin routine, on exfoliation night. I use at serum stage after an AHA Korean toner and essence stage. Goes on clear and dries quickly before final seem/moisturizing stages.

I really liked this product after trying the acne clearing + tone gel, which was a little too harsh for my skin. I use this toner every other day because I notice I tend to break out if I use it too much/too often, but I feel like I have seen an improvement in my skin after using it for 4-6 weeks! It's very light and not overpowering in scent or texture. Highly recommend!

avis.titre: I would not buy this product again.
avis.texte: Based purely on the fact the pump just does not work I will not buy this again. I was told when I went back to the store to hold the bottle upside down to get the product out. Ridiculous. And it doesn't work. There are too many good products available to waste my time and money on this.

I've noticed a difference while using this. I use this every night now, I started off by using it every other night. My only complaint is the pump, it just squirts out everywhere! I use a cotton pad to apply so I put the nozzle right into the pad.
I do like this product, I use it everyday. It says 1-2 pumps but I think 3-4 makes more sense for my skin routine. It kind of absorbs into the pad and then feels like there isn't much more on there.
This is the best toner I have ever used! My face looks and feels better, even after the first few days I used it!
This product does exactly what it's suppose to. My face has been really oily at the end of the day and I use this first and it never looks or feels oily anymore!
Amazing. I suffered from acne and I I noticed an improvement in my skin immediately afterwards. I forgot to use it a few times and noticed how much my skin really needed it. A little goes a long way
This is the best performing aha I have ever tried! Lightweight gel formula is easy to use and just one pump covers entire face and neck area!

After a few weeks of using this toner, the pump stopped working. I can hear there's still a ton of product inside when I shake it, but it simply won't come out. The only way to get it out is to literally break the packaging. Why does every Tula pump fail?
bought this and it helped calm down all my jawline acne. I use it with the Bliss acne treatment and works twice as fast and better! highly suggest

This product worked for about a week. It brighten my skin and improved the texture but after about a week, my breakouts became worse. Read the label on the bottle because it says to wear sunscreen and limit sun exposure because it could cause a sunburn/make it worse. I'm not sure how good a product is for your skin if you're supposed to limit sun exposure, even a week after you're done using it.
Really didn't do anything for my skin. There was also a very bad fragrance that was in it which wasn't pleasant for me.

I wanted to like this and bought it due to it having great ratings. But when I use this product, I break out even worse. It makes my hormonal acne very deep and cystic like. As soon as I stop using it, my skin is less inflamed. Wish I could return!

I love this toner. It is one of the best ones I have ever tried without a doubt. My skin. I have combination skin with an oily T-zone area. I also get heavy cystic acne in my beard and hair follicles. This toner makes my skin feel so clean and well-toned after a good face cleaning. It has definitely almost eliminated my breakout issues. If I do still get a breakout, this toner has the top skin layer peeling by the next day and growing in new skin!!!! I only have two issues with this toner. 1) Sometimes the pump comes defective. I've noticed when I get one with a pump issue, I usually have to hold it upside down to get the toner to flow. That or twist off the top (Yes, it does twist off!). 2) The size. I wish they made this in a bigger size than the 3 Oz bottle. But oh well. Note- Since as a guy I have a beard, I don't follow the instructions on the bottle. It says to pump it onto a cotton pad and swab your face. However, the cotton just gets stuck in my facial hair. Instead, I just pump it directly onto my fingertips and rub it in. Works great!

This toner burned my face so bad. I expected maybe a tingly-sensation when putting it on because it is a resurfacing treatment, but all this product left me was burns. This product may work for some people, but maybe not for others! (and that's okay)
Feels like a fresh restart to my face every evening and morning!
this tone doesn't leave my skin dried out or cracky. i have received compliments that my skin is GLOWING
I use this product in the mornings and evenings after my cleanser. I love that it doesn't have a harsh feel or smell to it. Great toner for my skin care routine
Definitely has helped my skin feel more hydrated and less dry!
Cannot tell a difference in my skin. Toner is extremely hard to get out of the bottle.

avis.titre: The dispensing pump for the toner never works
avis.texte: I reviewed this product before buying it and I saw a lot of complains about the dispensing pump for this product. Regardless, I purchased this product thinking the issue should have been fixed by now. I was so disappointed that the pump never worked when I received the toner. The annoying part is your product is pricey and the quality control dept can't ensure that the containers/dispensing pump is working effectively. Please I don't not need the we are sorry response under this review. TULA GO AND FIX THE DISPENSING PUMP ISSUE FOR THIS PARTICULAR PRODUCT.
great products!! really refreshing on my skin. 10/10 recommend.
Perfect toner! My skin feels refreshed and clean. So light and purifying!

Easy to apply right after washing my face. The pro-glycolic 10% resurfacing treatment absorbs quickly and does not leave a sticky residue. I have noticed that my face looks more even toned and the wrinkles on my forehead seem to be less deep.
Makes my skin feel smooth and I can see my dark spots getting lighter.

I'm so disappointed with Tula's line. This is my fourth purchase from them (not including samples) and everything is just a let down. No noticeable difference in my skin. It has a slight burn after taking forever to absorb. Made no difference in tone, texture or brightness. I've been using almost a month! Not a horrible product, but I was expecting MUCH more for the price. If you're looking for an effective acid product, trust me this isn't it. There are other lines for half this price that work way better.

I started using this around January 2022, have been purchasing since. They have changed the packaging and I do feel like I don't get as much product for the increase in price. However, it is a good toner. I recommend it.
I love it! I can feel it working as I put it on with a cotton pad. Great customer service! Absolutely terrific quality staffers!
This formula took some getting use to but I love it. We t doesn't dry out or make my face red like other toners I have used do. This has been a game changer for me.

I love this product and bought it to help with some old acne scars which it definitely did. I'll be keeping this in my routine. My only con is the price which I feel is expensive but you get what you pay for and it is worth it overall.

I like the fact that this toner does more than just clear the skin after cleansing. I do not use a cotton pad to apply, however, as too much gets absorbed. Glad I bought this product and will continue to use.

I read a lot of reviews that said the pumps were coming broken. But mine did not . I haven't really noticed anything changes in my skin but I have only had it for about 2 weeks. It's kinda thick and jelly like which I really like . Makes my face alittle red at first but it goes away a short while after using and applying my face cream . I'm not entirely sure I'm glad I purchased it yet but hopefully I will be in time . If not lesson learned and I'll look for something else .

I purchased this Tula Pro-Glycolic a few weeks ago to get the benefit of an AHA into my regular rotation, and since the 2nd ingredient is glycolic acid I felt this would be a great starter. I've been using retinA for the past 5 months for its anti-aging benefits and now that my skin is used to a full strength pharmaceutical retinoid I knew it was time to add an AHA specifically (glycolic) and I know Tula as a brand is pretty tolerable for sensitive skin, I really love this toner! I'm already noticing it working. It's not harsh and hasn't caused me to break out at all. I've used it like a serum and also like a regular toner, I feel like using it as a serum is my favorite way and it dries down perfectly too. To me it's not greasy, it's a lovely consistency. No pilling or any of that nonsense. I haven't had any trouble with the pump, I just hold the pump down and the product comes out as expected, either into my hand or on a reusable cotton round. I've used this at night as well as in the morning, but I feel like once a day is enough unless I'm feeling super dry. It's a nice combination with my other serum and my moisturizer before sunscreen in the morning. I'm really happy I decided to give this toner a try. There are cheaper alternatives but these ingredients are completely worth it. Especially since I'm super happy with the results so far, I'm actually surprised at how well it works, even using it once a day. I'm in my mid forties and have combination skin, if anyone is wonde
Leaves my skin looking brighter than ever! Can't wait to buy more products!

It works as intended. It's not designed to use a long straw like your liquid hand soap. Turn the bottle upside down and pump onto a cotton ball or your swiper of choice. Anyway it works amazing and I love it. I never used a toner before because they dry me out. This is so well balanced and really keeps my pores clean.
I have sensitive skin and this product did not irritate my skin, good few ingredients too
I have sensitive skin and this product did not irritate my skin, good few ingredients too
I have sensitive skin and this product did not irritate my skin, good few ingredients too

I love this product. It has been a staple in my morning/night routine during all seasons. I'm not picky, but I have tried skincare products across the board, from 50+ companies, and they just can't compete. I am Eastern-European and have an oily t-zone to the point where if I eat, I'm oily-skinned within about 15 minutes. As odd as it sounds, my oily skin doesn't cause breakouts but products usually do. I don't have sensitive skin, either. I'm not allergic to anything, even poison ivy/sumac, don't get rashes, etc. but a drop of foundation left on for 15 minutes causes acne (I've tried at least 20 companies' products to test this as well.) The gel-consistency of this product leaves my skin feeling tacky for about 10 minutes then sinks in, seamlessly. After a week of use, my skin felt refreshed, moisturized, and less oily. It's not a drying product, either. My t-zone has been less oily, but my cheeks and chin don't feel drier. I'm truly fascinated that one product works so beautifully on multi-faceted areas. I hope they never retire this product because if they do, I can say in full honestly that I'd be more upset than I was over my divorce. This is something I'll purchase for life and some things do stand the test of time.

avis.titre: Lasts a long time no issues with pump!
avis.texte: I used this every day mostly twice a day and it seems to last me almost a year! I've been through 1 and a half bottles in a year and a halfZ I use one or two pumps on my clean face. For those of you who have had problems with the pump, I feel really sorry, so far I have had no problems at all! You can return it to ulta. And exchange if for another bottle if it's defective though. I just pump it into my hand, rub it once with my other hand (clean hands) and then wipe across my clean face. Then you can use a cotton pad to wipe it on your face and get rid of the excess. I don't notice a big change just consistent smoothness. I like using toners so I recommend this as it multitasks.

Glycolic Acid is one of those things you just have to know how to use with your skin. This is the least irritating exfoliating toner I've tried. Great for everyday use but be careful not to over strip your skin. I use this often daily and when followed up with good moisturizing and spf practices, this delivers results! I had better skin texture and a more even skin tone after the first use! I tend to use it at night because my skin is easily irritated. I have combination skin and I find this treats all areas of my face nicely. However, I don't use a cotton pad, I use only a single pump and apply it directly to my face. Once a week or so I use a more concentrated glycolic solution to wipe away all the build up. I find after introducing this into the rest of the week, my skin is healthier and better exfoliated. When I go to check the round on exfoliation days, there's way less dirt and grime than before I started using this Tula toner regularly. I'm so glad I got it on sale!

I'm on my 5th bottle of this- so that should tell you I'm a huge fan! I just wish the pump/dispenser was better. It is very finicky and inconsistently disperses product (sometimes too much, sometimes not Enough) for the price, it shouldn't be the case. This is better than Paula's choice toner. Instant hydration/helps breakouts!!!
